verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships a public API reference/testing UI (readme-docs-1), an official CLI 'rdme' for docs-as-code workflows verified live (readme-probe-rt-3, readme-probe-3), bi-directional GitHub/GitLab sync (readme-docs-11/26) and an MCP server exposing project docs to AI agents (readme-probe-rt-2), showing real programmatic parity for core content-management tasks. However there's no evidence that every UI capability (custom domains, CSS customization, Reviews workflow, Docs Audit/Linter rules, versioning, analytics dashboards) is exposed via a documented API/CLI endpoint, so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit API/CLI coverage for custom domain setup, CSS/JS customization, Reviews approval flow, Docs Audit/Linter execution, and version management.
